doc_title_en: Notification of Revision of FY2026/9 Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2026年9月期通期業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 2026年9月期の業績予想の修正を踏まえ、経営成績、財政状態及び配当利回り等を総合的に勘案し、株主還元の更なる充実を図るため

summary_en: ¥37/share annual dividend (¥3 increase from ¥34 forecast); payout ratio 85.5%; interim ¥37, year-end ¥37; FY2026/9 (ended September 2026). Driven by upward revision of earnings forecast (net income ¥966M vs. ¥908M prior forecast), achieved through higher Wevox profitability and cost efficiencies despite Green segment headwinds and strategic investment execution.
summary_jp: 年間配当37円/株（34円予想から3円増配）；配当性向85.5%；中間37円、期末37円；FY2026/9。業績予想の上方修正（当期純利益966百万円vs.前回予想908百万円）に基づく—Wevox の高収益案件獲得とコスト効率化による。
tag_en: Dividend hike – ¥37/share (¥3 increase) – FY2026/9 – payout ratio 85.5%
tag_jp: 配当増配 – 37円/株（3円増） – FY2026/9 – 配当性向85.5%

summary_en: ¥34/share (¥1 increase from ¥33); payout ratio 83.6% for FY9/26. Record date moved to 31 October (from end-September) following shift of annual shareholder meeting to January.
